svg.title: How the checksum is computed

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Checksum: a 16-bit sum, not a CRC

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The checksum is the sum of all payload bytes, truncated to 16 bits. The 8 header bytes are not included.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Example: GET_PROPERTY fwversion (0x81), transaction 2, as captured

svg.text: 0x02 + 0x64 + 0x81 = 0x00e7 (all other bytes are zero). Stored little-endian in header bytes 6–7: e7 00

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only the low 16 bits are kept: 300 bytes of 0xff add up to 0x12ad4, so the checksum field is 0x2ad4.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Receivers check the sum and drop frames that do not match; they then search for the next magic word (resynchronisation).
